# Understanding Tide Pools

## What is a tide pool?

A tide pool is a rocky pool on the seashore which is separated from the sea at low tide, filled with seawater. Many tide pools are habitats of especially adaptable animals that have engaged the attention of naturalists and marine biologists, as well as philosophical essayists. Anemones, sea stars and urchins are common.

Visit the anemone guide or read the reference for more. Also jump and nothing.
